correctness.rationale: Choose ordered spare positions disjoint from requested output values; allocate prescribed disjoint directed edges across cycles using c(λ)=Σ⌊ℓ/2⌋ slots; close each cycle after inserting the remaining singleton vertices. The resulting permutation has exact type λ and produces the requested subword. Equality with the ambient lower CW skeleton plus classical full-injective-word sphere connectivity establishes π_i=0 through i=c−2. For fixed-point-free involutions each two-cycle yields a forced inversion, excluding all increasing subwords longer than m. The construction was cross-checked exhaustively up to eight labels and for many twelve-label inputs; finite checks are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The theorem supplies one computable cycle-type capacity governing exact short-subword universality and a higher homotopy vanishing range for every conjugacy class, improving the recently established qualitative free-π1 statement in high-capacity families. The natural class of perfect-matching involutions has a provably sharp skeletal threshold. It is an infinite structural result rather than a finite table or routine numeric corollary.
